Latest Microsoft and security updates

What's changing, what it means for your business, and what to do. Plain English, no jargon.

View all updates →
EG Eloma newsFor information13 Nov 2026

New: request a quote and attach your files

You can now request a fixed written quote online and attach screenshots of your current software, subscription invoices or a brief. It helps us give you an accurate quote faster.

Microsoft updateAction required10 Nov 2026

Still using Windows 10? Plan your upgrade now

Microsoft ended support for Windows 10 on 14 October 2025, so those computers no longer get free security updates. Microsoft 365 apps still get security updates on Windows 10 until October 2028, but the computer itself is exposed.

Security advisoryRecommended5 Nov 2026

Watch out for fake Microsoft 365 sign-in emails

Scam emails that look like Microsoft 365 messages ("your mailbox is full", "shared document", "password expires") try to steal staff passwords. They often use real Microsoft logos and urgent wording.

FAQ

Common questions

What digital marketing services do you offer?

SEO, Google and Meta Ads, PPC across Google, Microsoft, LinkedIn and YouTube, social media management, Google Business Profile management and design. You can pick a single service or a monthly plan that combines them.

Can custom software replace our monthly subscriptions?

Yes. We map the apps you pay for today, such as CRM, invoicing, bookings, inventory and help desk, and build one system that covers those operations. You own it, so there are no per-user licence fees.

Who can maintain the software after it's built?

You get the full source code and documentation. It's built on standard, widely used technology, so any developer or your own team can maintain it. We also offer ongoing support if you'd like us to look after it.

What does EG Eloma do?

EG Eloma is an Australian-owned technology partner based in Collingwood, Melbourne. We provide Microsoft 365 and licensing, websites and software, digital marketing, business phone systems, cloud services and cybersecurity, all managed by one team with one account manager.

Which countries do you work with?

Anywhere in the world. Our team is based in Melbourne, Australia, and we work remotely with any business that can communicate with us in English. Quotes are in Australian dollars (AUD) for Australian clients and US dollars (USD) for international clients.

How much do your plans cost?

Every plan is quoted, not listed, so you only pay for what you need. Quotes are itemised, written in plain English, valid for 30 days and show third-party ad spend separately.

Is support available 24/7?

Yes. Our helpdesk runs 24/7 and our average support response time is under 15 minutes.

Can charities get Microsoft 365 for free?

Eligible Australian charities may get Microsoft 365 Business Basic free for up to 300 users, plus discounted Business Premium and an annual Azure credit grant. Microsoft sets eligibility, and we can check it for you.

How long does a Microsoft 365 rollout take?

A typical Microsoft rollout takes about 90 days, from free consultation and fixed quote through to build, training and ongoing management.
